excerpt: This report, as part of the 2021 Snowmass Process, summarizes the current status of collider physics at the Energy Frontier, the broad and exciting future prospects identified for the Energy Frontier, the challenges and needs of future experiments.
publisher: arXiv (preprint); M. Narain, L. Reina, A. Tricoli et al. (35 authors)
title: The Future of US Particle Physics - The Snowmass 2021 Energy Frontier Report
